subject: Request: Security-funded VPC eval & credits for MegraTech POC
messages:
From: Alice Meyer <alice.meyer@megratech.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@megratech.com
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: security-funded VPC eval & credits

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the VPC isolation and audit log features are exactly what our infra team needs for a regulated POC. We're ready to run a 60–90 day eval but have two gating items from security and procurement:

- Our security team requires a SOC2 attestation (or equivalent evidence) and access to audit logs for the trial.
- We need an isolated VPC deployment with egress controls and IP allowlisting.
- Procurement is asking whether Redwood can provide credits to offset GPU costs for the first 90 days while we complete eval impact testing.

Attached is our short compliance questionnaire to speed review. Can Redwood approve a promotional credit package (or a trial extension) tied to meeting those controls? If you need an internal contact, cc'd procurement@megratech.com and our security alias.

Appreciate quick turnaround — aiming to kick off by Oct 6.

Best,
Alice Meyer
Director, Cloud Infrastructure
MegraTech

Attachment: megratech-compliance-questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf, 312 KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Meyer <alice.meyer@megratech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Sep 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security-funded VPC eval & credits

Alice — thanks for the clear summary and for sending the questionnaire. We're excited to run this with MegraTech. Quick read: the requirements are standard for our Private/VPC POCs but Procurement/Security approvals drive whether we can extend credit.

Proposed internal ask (for Laura + Karthik):
- Approve an upfront promo credit up to $15k to cover GPU/infra for a 60–90 day isolated POC, contingent on signing DPA + SOW and successful delivery of the SOC2 attestation or equivalent evidence for third-party controls.
- Require the POC to run in our dedicated VPC environment with IP allowlist and egress policy enforced; no data retention beyond POC window unless customer opts in.
- Add a clause to the SOW: credits expire 30 days after POC end if not applied to a committed purchase.

Alice — if that sounds reasonable I can champion the approval and start the DocuSign SOW + DPA workflow. I attached the initial scope MegraTech sent so we have it inline.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: megratech-initial-scope.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48 KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2025 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security-funded VPC eval & credits

Ben / Karthik —

Thanks for looping me in. High level position from Legal & Finance: we can approve a targeted promotional allowance for security-gated evaluations but with explicit guardrails. Proposed approval terms: 

1) Promotional allowance: $12,000 applied as credits against usage for a single 60-day POC. We prefer a fixed allowance rather than an open-ended $15k to reduce revenue exposure.

2) Conditions:
   - DPA executed and redlines accepted (we can use our standard DPA; any substantive changes will require legal review and may delay start).
   - Customer provides SOC2 Type II report OR an equivalent third-party security attestation prior to the start date, OR signs an attestation confirming no regulated customer data will be processed during the POC.
   - POC must run in Redwood Private VPC with egress rules and IP allowlisting enabled by our infra team.

3) SOW: must include timeline, acceptance criteria, and a clause that unused credits expire 30 days after POC completion. Any extension beyond 60 days requires written approval and additional credits.

4) Procurement: we need the procurement contact to confirm SOW acceptance and complete a short purchase order form that acknowledges the promotional credit conditions.

If those are acceptable, I can approve the $12k allowance and instruct ops to reserve capacity. If not, please document the customer ask and potential upsides for higher exposure.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations & Legal (acting)
Redwood Inference
